title: Flu clinic every Tuesday
body: Walk-in flu shots are available every Tuesday from 9am to noon. No appointment needed.

title: New online repeat prescriptions
body: You can now request repeat prescriptions from your portal account. Allow two working days.

title: Car park resurfacing
body: The west car park is closed for resurfacing until the end of the month. Please use the street entrance.

title: Measles vaccination reminder
body: Children aged 1 to 5 are due their second MMR dose. Call reception to book.
